name: Aider
verdict: A free Apache-2.0 terminal pair programmer; the only bill is the model API key you bring.
pros: Works in the terminal against your own repo
cons: You pay token prices with no included allowance
Less polished than an editor subscription
pricingNote: aider.chat shows install-and-bring-a-key usage and does not list a paid plan. The Apache-2.0 license is on the official GitHub repository.
